column1: # The review findings the hostile-value library was built from: every finding
# of the 2026-11-19 audit of codex review logs that needed a contrived input
#   id         the audit's model and the finding's log and position
#   where      the file the finding cites, or - where the audit recorded none
#   dimension  the dimension that generates the finding's input, or
#   outcome    reproduces: <census>   a generated case fails with the fix reverted
#              declines: <census>     the subject declines the generated case
#              pending                on main, and no harness draws the dimension yet
#              branch: <name>         the code reviewed is on a branch not yet merged
